linked.title: Linked plots
linked.caption: Pan or zoom either view. The other follows.
linked.description: Pass one shared object to linkInfo and choose the bounds to synchronize. Here both plots share xmin and xmax, while keeping separate y ranges.

themes.title: Themes
themes.caption: Try the theme button in the corner of the graph.
themes.description: Each graph starts with the browser color preference. Its theme button switches light/dark mode. Set plot.theme to auto, light, or dark, and optionally set plot.themeColors to override individual colors.

controls.title: Zooming & panning
controls.caption: Drag to pan. Scroll over the graph or an axis margin.
controls.description: Mouse pan and wheel zoom work automatically. Scroll below the x axis or left of the y axis to zoom that axis alone. Two-finger gestures support touch navigation.
